messages:
Sam S: FYI customer Acme Analytics just escalated — their A/B rollout dashboard shows Variant B ~60% and Variant A ~40% since yesterday but their assignment API logs show the opposite. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/9876
Maria C: thanks, sending to eng. @Kevin L can you take a look? customer hitting analytics for revenue reporting so high priority :exclamation:
Kevin L: on it. quick q — is this across all cohorts or single experiment? any screenshots from customer?
Sam S: single experiment, cohorts 0/1 both flipped. screenshot attached in the ticket, and they pasted the query they run against our /insights endpoint.
Support Bot: Incident created INC-2026-1337, severity P2. Ops Oncall assigned.
Ops Oncall: I pulled the metrics pipeline logs — ingestion seems healthy, but I see a mapping change in rollout_metadata table at 2026-11-03T03:12Z (variant_key normalization).
Kevin L: that mapping change rings a bell — we deployed a normalizer that lowercases variant keys to dedupe. Could be variant key collision if customer used case-sensitive keys.
Maria C: customer says they never changed keys. they use keys: "A", "B". If normalizer ran, that wouldn't swap counts. Could be hash seed or bucketing logic change.
Kevin L: running local repro now. steps: 1) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rollouts/assignments?exp=exp_123&date=2026-11-03" 2) compare with DB: SELECT cohort, variant_key, COUNT(*) FROM assignments WHERE exp_id='exp_123' AND date='2026-11-03' GROUP BY cohort, variant_key;
Kevin L: initial quick check: assignment ledger shows 40% A / 60% B; dashboard aggregation (aggregator service) shows 60% A / 40% B. So the mismatch is in the aggregator step.
Ops Oncall: the aggregator merges assignment rows and uses variant_id in some paths, variant_key in others. I see a join on variant_id that was recently changed to join on variant_label in the new PR #4210.
Maria C: hmm customer’s rollout used custom variant labels that are not unique across experiments — could cause cross-experiment counts if join is wrong.
Kevin L: reproduced locally by creating two experiments with identical labels. aggregator was attributing counts to the wrong experiment when variant_label collision occurred.
Sam S: customer impact — reported incorrect chart and downstream reports are wrong. They want ETA and mitigation.
Kevin L: immediate mitigation: revert join to use fully scoped variant_id and deploy a rollback to aggregator service. I can cut a patch now.
Ops Oncall: pre-deploy checks passing in staging. Will schedule hotfix to production in 15m and monitor.
Maria C: I'll update the customer with a short explanation + ETA and ask them to hold off reporting until fix.
Support Bot: Deployment scheduled: patch/aggregator-fix -> prod at 2026-11-03T15:40Z by Kevin L.
Kevin L: deployed hotfix, rolling 3 instances. Monitoring shows assignment counts now match ledger for the last 30m.
Sam S: relayed to customer, they confirmed charts corrected in their tenant. they asked for a postmortem and whether any exported csvs were impacted.
Kevin L: will do a quick sweep for exported reports — likely affected if generated between 2026-11-03T03:12Z and fix time. I'll add a list of impacted tenants.
Maria C: thanks. I'll draft the customer message and CC legal for any sensitive reporting.
Ops Oncall: closing INC-2026-1337 once PM/eng confirm postmortem.
Kevin L: note for postmortem: root cause = aggregator PR #4210 changed join key from scoped variant_id -> unsuffixed variant_label; secondary cause = lack of uniqueness guard + insufficient integration test for label collisions. Fix: hotfix + add integration test + telemetry to alert on inconsistent ledger vs aggregator percentages.
Sam S: perfect. I'll attach logs and repro steps to the ticket and notify customer when postmortem is ready. :thumbsup:
